criteria.otherMatchups: every other non-mirror matchup quota A in [0.40,0.60]
criteria.duration: mean turns per matchup (mirrors included) in [6,12]
criteria.draws: draws <= 10% in every matchup, mirrors included (D51)

violationUnit: one per (matchup, criterion); one per invariant kind or violating bound
adoption: a candidate with zero violations; otherwise the fewest violations, tie broken by fewer draw violations, then by lower maximum draw %. If control wins, the draft is unchanged.
